name: Umbrella StakingRewards unchecked withdrawal accounting
summary: StakingRewards.withdraw() subtracted the caller-supplied amount from total supply and the caller's zero balance without checked arithmetic. Under Solidity 0.7 the values wrapped instead of reverting, so an unstaked caller could withdraw the pool's entire UNI-V2 balance.
notes: The direct StakingRewards runtime containing the unchecked withdrawal subtraction was installed by this top-level contract creation.

The selected Ethereum transaction transfers the target's exact entire balance of 8,792.873290680252648282 UMB/WETH UNI-V2 tokens. USD is immediate pre-transaction pool NAV: the stolen share represented 2,235,385.212219056057355257 UMB and 92.244534420912291405 WETH; both reserve sides are marked at the pool spot ratio and WETH uses the incident-time price.
